systems.name: Scaffold, attribution, pack script
systems.smoke: python3 tools/pack-adastra.py writes mods/adastra/dist/adastra.hmod with POSIX paths, horizon-mod.toml, and horizon-native.json. Join a world and expect the Ad Astra Horizon 0.1.0 login line.

systems.name: Materials and moon/mars blocksets
systems.smoke: /give @s adastra:desh_ingot, adastra:moon_stone, adastra:mars_stone, adastra:cheese, adastra:flag. Place the stones; craft cobble from stone.

systems.name: FE buffer, coal generator, solar
systems.smoke: Place adastra:coal_generator with coal in slot 0 beside a machine. Energy gauge fills. Place adastra:solar_panel; daytime FE accumulates in its buffer.

systems.name: Compressor plates
systems.smoke: Place adastra:compressor next to a charged generator. Put adastra:desh_ingot or steel_ingot in the input; take the plate. FE drains while progressing.

systems.name: Oxygen, suit, vacuum marker
systems.smoke: Use suit pieces to don. Fill adastra:oxygen_tank at adastra:oxygen_loader. Action bar shows O2. Stand near adastra:vacuum_marker without a sealed suit: chat reports vacuum damage.

systems.name: Fuel refinery
systems.smoke: Put adastra:oil in adastra:fuel_refinery with FE; take adastra:rocket_fuel.

systems.name: NASA workbench and rocket stub
systems.smoke: Craft adastra:rocket_t1 at the workbench recipes. Use the rocket: countdown chat, then launch stub (dimensions blocked).

systems.name: Oxygen distributor
systems.smoke: Place adastra:oxygen_distributor with FE and an oxygen tank inside a vacuum marker zone; sealed breathing resumes without suit drain while in range.

systems.name: Cryo freezer
systems.smoke: adastra:cryo_freezer turns ice / blue ice into adastra:ice_shard (≥2 recipes) when powered.

systems.name: Gravity stub and pack notes
systems.smoke: Stand on moon_stone or mars_stone: action bar shows low-g. Pack agent follows docs/adastra-plan.md smoke contract; keep on=[] until /give works.

systems.name: Custom dimensions / planet travel
systems.smoke: Horizon dimensions API not available on hooks 411. Rockets stay launch stubs.
